title: Correct renewal-date extraction in a prompt trial
method: Synthetic fixed set of 40 contracts. Correct extraction requires the renewal date or the defined absent value. Rates are 75% and 85%. This small example illustrates controlled comparison rather than a general model capability claim.
alt: Correct renewal-date extraction in a prompt trial. Original instruction: 30 documents out of 40, Revised instruction: 34 documents out of 40. Illustrative data.
